questions.q: What did Elisha ask of Elijah before he was taken?
options: A double portion of his spirit
questions.evidence: Elisha said, “Please let a double portion of your spirit be on me

questions.q: How did Elijah go up into heaven?
questions.evidence: As they continued on and talked, behold, a chariot of fire and horses of fire separated them, and Elijah went up by a whirlwind into heaven

questions.q: What filled the widow's borrowed containers until there were none left?
How many times did Naaman dip himself in the Jordan?
questions.evidence: Then went he down, and dipped himself seven times in the Jordan, according to the saying of the man of God

questions.q: When Elisha threw a stick into the water, what floated?
questions.evidence: He cut down a stick, threw it in there, and made the iron float

questions.q: Who painted her eyes and looked out of the window when Jehu came to Jezreel?
questions.evidence: When Jehu had come to Jezreel, Jezebel heard of it; and she painted her eyes, and adorned her head, and looked out at the window

questions.q: Which king took Samaria and carried Israel away?
questions.evidence: In the ninth year of Hoshea the king of Assyria took Samaria, and carried Israel away to Assyria, and placed them in Halah, and on the Habor, the river of Gozan, and in the cities of the Medes

questions.q: What came out of the woods when the youths mocked Elisha?
questions.evidence: Then two female bears came out of the woods, and mauled forty-two of those youths

questions.q: What did Hilkiah the high priest find in Yahweh's house?
questions.evidence: Hilkiah the high priest said to Shaphan the scribe, “I have found the book of the law in Yahweh’s house

questions.q: What happened to Yahweh's house when Jerusalem fell?
questions.evidence: He burned Yahweh’s house, the king’s house, and all the houses of Jerusalem, even every great house, he burned with fire
